_comment: Single merged config for the SALOME Assistant. It feeds BOTH the chatbot (query time) and the extraction pipeline (index build time). Chatbot-only keys are ignored by the extractor; extraction-only keys (output_dir, use_token_chunking, modules, chunking, quality) are ignored by the chatbot.
_comment_project_name: No spaces — used as the ChromaDB collection name.

embedding._comment_type: 'local' uses sentence-transformers locally; 'api' uses an OpenAI-compatible embeddings endpoint.
embedding._comment_match: SHARED by extraction and chatbot — must stay identical between an index and the chatbot that queries it, or retrieval silently returns wrong results.

_comment_chromadb_path: Relative paths are resolved against this config file's directory. Must point inside the extraction output_dir.

llm._comment_base_url: OpenAI-compatible endpoint. Ollama: http://localhost:11434/v1 · llama.cpp/vLLM: http://localhost:8080/v1 · OpenAI: https://api.openai.com/v1
llm._comment_api_key: Use 'dummy' for local servers; your real key for hosted providers.

_comment_reranker: Set to null to disable. Enable with {"model": "BAAI/bge-reranker-v2-m3", "type": "local"} (requires sentence-transformers).
_comment_agentic: Set to null to disable the Agentic mode. Enable with {"page_index_path": "./salome_docs_extracted/page_index.json", "max_chars_per_page": 8000, "max_steps": 6}. Requires the 'smolagents' package.
_comment_max_tokens: LLM answer length (chatbot). Distinct from chunking.max_tokens below (extraction chunk size).
_comment_extraction_section: ===== Extraction pipeline (index build time, used by the 'Build index' button) =====
_comment_output_dir: Where ChromaDB + page_index.json are written. chromadb_path above must be output_dir + '/chromadb'.
_comment_token_chunking: Token chunking is more precise but MUCH slower; use false for large doc sets.
_comment_modules: dev_path = API reference (Doxygen, share/doc/salome/tui/<MODULE>) · user_path = user guide (Sphinx, share/doc/salome/gui/<MODULE>). Both optional per module. Paths may use SALOME's own $<MODULE>_ROOT_DIR / $DOCUMENTATION_ROOT_DIR environment variables (see env_launch.sh) — these are set whenever the assistant is launched from the SALOME Plugins menu, so the config stays correct regardless of where config.json itself is saved. Plain relative paths (resolved against this config file's directory) and absolute paths still work too.
_comment_modules_citation: url_for_sources_citation turns each retrieved chunk into a clickable link to the public docs (https://docs.salome-platform.org/latest/...), which mirrors the same tui/gui/<MODULE> layout as the local build. It may be a single string, or — as used below for dev+user modules — a {"dev": ..., "user": ...} mapping so each doc_category cites its own online tree instead of the dev URL being reused for user pages. Verified live against docs.salome-platform.org/latest. IMPORTANT: keys directly under "modules" must each be a module dict — process_docs.py iterates every one of them as such, so no _comment* key belongs inside "modules" itself (only inside an individual module's dict, which is fine).

GEOM.description: Geometry module — CAD construction and manipulation.

SMESH.description: Mesh module — meshing algorithms and mesh editing.
SMESH._comment_user_path: share/doc/salome/gui/<MODULE> is a symlink into $<MODULE>_ROOT_DIR itself, so $SMESH_ROOT_DIR/share/doc/salome/gui/SMESH resolves to the exact same files — either form works.

NETGENPLUGIN.description: NETGEN meshing algorithm plugin for SMESH.
NETGENPLUGIN._comment: No Doxygen (tui/) API reference is built for this plugin — user_path only.

GMSHPLUGIN.description: Gmsh meshing algorithm plugin for SMESH.
GMSHPLUGIN._comment: No Doxygen (tui/) API reference is built for this plugin — user_path only.

DOCUMENTATION.description: General SALOME platform documentation — installation, concepts, cross-module index.
DOCUMENTATION._comment: The platform-wide docs have no per-module API reference — user_path only.
